name: Terra State Community College
academic_ranking: Public two-year community college in Fremont, Ohio (NCES/College Scorecard). Open-enrollment associate degree and certificate programs. Overall completion/graduation rate approximately 37% (federal College Scorecard, latest available).
financial_aid: In-state tuition approximately $5,748/year; out-of-state approximately $8,544/year (federal College Scorecard, latest available). Pell Grant recipient rate approximately 27%. As a two-year public institution, students commonly use federal Pell/loans, state aid, and institutional/athletic scholarships.
facilities_notes: Titans softball plays at the Terra State campus, 2830 Napoleon Rd., Fremont, OH 43420. Specific softball facility details (field name, indoor training) were not publicly detailed on the athletics site as of the research date.
program_reputation: NJCAA Division III (District/Region 12) program competing in the Ohio Community College Athletic Conference (OCCAC). Recent season overall record 12-13 (8-10 conference) with a JUCO Division III District 12 Runner-Up finish, per team pages. Emerging program under head coach Troy Lewis, in his third season at TSCC.
notes: Researched live 2026-07-30. Athletics site (terrastatetitans.com / PrestoSports) blocks default automated fetchers (HTTP 403); pages were retrieved via a standard browser user agent. Coaches page lists only a head coach; no assistant coaches, recruiting coordinators, or graduate/volunteer assistants were listed in the softball staff directory as of this date. Tuition and aid figures sourced from the U.S. Dept. of Education College Scorecard. Roster size counted from the 2025-26 softball roster page (15 players).
